# Yomikai 2.0.0 startup slowness — findings (research only)

## Summary of the critical structural problem
Two large, independent main-thread blocks exist before the first frame is drawn:
1. `MainActivity.onCreate` literally **`runBlocking`s on the UI thread** waiting for all DB/WorkManager migrations (`MainActivity.kt:179`).
2. `AppModule` claims to init expensive singletons "asynchronously" but uses `ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(...)` — i.e. the **main thread** (`AppModule.kt:151-160`). This constructs the SQLite `Database`, OkHttp `NetworkHelper`, `SourceManager` → `ExtensionManager` (which synchronously loads every extension APK), and `DownloadManager` on the UI thread.

Additionally, two OCR stores are read from disk synchronously during `Application.onCreate` (`App.kt:148`, `App.kt:160`).

---

## Ranked culprits

### 1. `Migrator.awaitAndRelease()` — runBlocking on the main thread
- `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/ui/main/MainActivity.kt:179` calls `Migrator.awaitAndRelease()` directly in `onCreate` (main thread).
- `app/src/main/java/mihon/core/migration/Migrator.kt:38-40` implements it as `runBlocking { await()... }`.
- Effect: the UI thread is **fully blocked until every registered migration finishes** (DB queries, WorkManager enqueue, preferences). Because the splash `ready` flag is only set later in a `LaunchedEffect` (`MainActivity.kt:215-230`, splash kept up to `SPLASH_MAX_DURATION=5000`, line 556), this directly shows up as a slow/long splash.
- Migrations are started from `App.kt:251` → `initializeMigrator()` (`App.kt:255-268`).
- Worse: `app/src/main/java/mihon/core/migration/MigrationJobFactory.kt:22` uses `async(start = CoroutineStart.UNDISPATCHED)`, so the **first non-suspending migrations execute on the caller's thread (main)** during `App.onCreate`. The `ALWAYS` ones sort first (`Migration.ALWAYS = -1f`, `Migration.kt:12`):
  - `SetupBackupCreateMigration.kt:11-15` → `BackupCreateJob.setupTask` → `context.workManager.enqueueUniquePeriodicWork(...)` (blocking WorkManager DB/disk write) — `BackupCreateJob.kt:90-114`, no `withIOContext`.
  - `SetupLibraryUpdateMigration.kt:11-15` → `LibraryUpdateJob.setupTask` → same `enqueueUniquePeriodicWork` — `LibraryUpdateJob.kt:413-459`.
  - `InstallationIdMigration.kt:13-17` preference read/write, no `withIOContext`.
- Upgrade path additionally blocks on IO migrations: `TrustExtensionRepositoryMigration.kt:14`, `CategoryPreferencesCleanupMigration.kt:13`, `SetupDictionaryOcrPresentationMigration.kt:13`, `VerticalNavigatorMigration.kt:13`.
- Verdict: **on main thread** (runBlocking) and the first `ALWAYS` migrations also execute on main. Highest-impact.

### 2. `AppModule` "async" init is actually the main thread
`app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/di/AppModule.kt:151-160`
```
// Asynchronously init expensive components for a faster cold start
ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(app).execute {
    get<NetworkHelper>(); get<SourceManager>(); get<Database>(); get<DownloadManager>()
}
```
`getMainExecutor` = main thread. Each of these is heavy:
- `get<Database>()` (`AppModule.kt:86-101`) resolves the `SqlDriver` (`AppModule.kt:71-85`: `BundledSQLiteDriver` + `AndroidxSqliteDriver(... schema = Database.Schema ...)`), i.e. **opens `tachiyomi.db` and runs schema create/migration on the UI thread**.
- `get<SourceManager>()` (`AppModule.kt:134`) constructs `AndroidSourceManager` (`AndroidSourceManager.kt:27`), which requires `ExtensionManager` (`AppModule.kt:135`). `ExtensionManager`'s `init` (`ExtensionManager.kt:74-77`) calls `initExtensions()` (`ExtensionManager.kt:120-132`), which calls `ExtensionLoader.loadExtensions` (`ExtensionLoader.kt:120-171`): `PackageManager.getInstalledPackages(...)` (line 124) plus **`runBlocking { extPkgs.map { async { loadExtension } }.awaitAll() }`** (lines 166-171) — loading every installed extension APK/class on the main thread. This is likely the single largest UI-thread stall.
- `get<NetworkHelper>()` (`AppModule.kt:131`) → `NetworkHelper.kt:18-92` builds OkHttp clients, 5 MB disk cache, cookie jar, DoH, proxy/interceptor setup.
- `get<DownloadManager>()` (`AppModule.kt:138`) → `DownloadManager.kt:36-56` constructs `Downloader` (`Downloader.kt:75-125`, resolves several DB interactors + `DownloadStore`), `DownloadPendingDeleter`.
- Verdict: **on main thread** despite the comment.

### 3. `OcrScreenshotBuffer.init()` — synchronous JSON read at `Application.onCreate`
- `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/App.kt:160` calls `mihon.data.ocr.OcrScreenshotBuffer.init(applicationContext)` directly in `onCreate`.
- `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/OcrScreenshotBuffer.kt:91-99` → `load()` at `OcrScreenshotBuffer.kt:482-495` does `file.readText()` + `json.decodeFromString<List<OcrScreenshotEntry>>` synchronously, for up to `maxEntries` (default 50, line 43) entries each containing OCR regions.
- Verdict: **on main thread** file I/O + JSON parse. Clear culprit.

### 4. `OcrVocabulary.configure()` — synchronous user-dictionary file read at startup
- `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/App.kt:148-150` calls `mihon.data.ocr.OcrVocabulary.configure(path)` in `onCreate`.
- `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/OcrVocabulary.kt:43-63`: `active.useLines { ... }` reads and tokenizes the entire `ocr_vocab.txt` (grows over time as words are learned), synchronously.
- Verdict: **on main thread**; size depends on accumulated user words.

### 5. `GetIncognitoState.await(null)` during first composition
- `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/ui/main/MainActivity.kt:190`: `remember { mutableStateOf(getIncognitoState.await(null)) }` runs during composition (main). `GetIncognitoState.kt:15-21` reads `BasePreferences.incognitoMode`; constructing it injects `ExtensionManager` (`GetIncognitoState.kt:10-14`), which may trigger #2's extension loading if not already done.
- Verdict: **on main thread**; mainly a pref read but linked to extension-manager construction.

### 6. `WidgetManager.init` → widget `updateAll` on main
- `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/App.kt:239` wires `WidgetManager(...).init(scope)`.
- `presentation-widget/.../WidgetManager.kt:22-41`: `getUpdates.subscribe(...)` / prefs are `.flowOn(Dispatchers.Default)`, but the downstream `.onEach { UpdatesGridGlanceWidget().updateAll(this); ... }` (lines 32-39) runs on the `launchIn(scope)` context, i.e. the ProcessLifecycle **main** scope. `updateAll` does Glance widget work (queries/IO).
- Verdict: partially main (the `onEach`/`updateAll` part); triggers on first flow emission at startup.

### 7. Miscellaneous main-thread preference reads/writes during `App.onCreate`
- `App.kt:162` `Injekt.get<OcrPreferences>().screenshotBufferSize().get()`.
- `App.kt:228-230` `hardwareBitmapThreshold.isSet()/set(...)` (write).
- `App.kt:236` `setAppCompatDelegateThemeMode(Injekt.get<UiPreferences>().themeMode.get())`.
- `App.kt:256-258` `last_version_code` read used to decide migrations.
- `MainActivity.kt:191` `preferences.downloadedOnly.collectAsState()` and `192` `downloadCache.isInitializing` (DownloadCache is mostly background; `DownloadCache.kt:102-124` uses IO scope).
- Verdict: each individually small, but they add up on the UI thread.

### 8. Injekt module registration
- `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/App.kt:130-132` `Injekt.importModule(PreferenceModule/AppModule/DomainModule)` runs on main. Registration itself is cheap (lambdas), but it is where the AppModule main-executor runnable (#2) is posted, and DomainModule factories get resolved eagerly by #2.

---

## Items that are correctly off the main thread (not culprits)
- `App.kt:97` Telemetry/Firebase init → `Thread` (MIN_PRIORITY).
- `App.kt:105-117` `AiHttpServer.start` → `Thread`.
- `App.kt:138-140` `Injekt.get<OcrScanManager>().startIfPending()` → `Thread` (`OcrScanManager.kt:45-49`).
- `App.kt:168-183` first-run directory creation → `Thread`.
- `App.kt:364-384` `ensureOcrModelsInstalled()` → `Thread` (MIN_PRIORITY); called from `MainActivity.kt:177`. Correctly background (downloads ~21 MB).
- `Migrator.scope = Dispatchers.IO` (`Migrator.kt:13`), `OcrModelDownloader.scope` IO (`OcrModelDownloader.kt:228`), `OcrRepositoryImpl.scope` IO (`OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:179`), `AndroidSourceManager.scope` IO (`AndroidSourceManager.kt:38`), `DownloadCache.scope` IO (`DownloadCache.kt:72`).

## First-use (not startup, but relevant to "slow UI loading")
- `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/RuWordList.kt:79-97`: the `upper` lazy allocates a `HashSet` for up to `EXPECTED_FORMS = 3_014_492` forms and reads the asset on first OCR text-clean (`OcrTextCleaner.kt:468`). `App.kt:156` only sets the opener, so this is deferred, but the first OCR pass pays a large CPU/memory cost.

## Systemic (not Yomikai-specific code, but main-thread at process start)
- No `androidx.work.Configuration.Provider` exists in code, so WorkManager initializes through `androidx.startup.InitializationProvider` (merged manifest) on the main thread at process start.
- `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:321-327` `rikka.shizuku.ShizukuProvider` `onCreate` also runs on the main thread when the process starts.

---

## Bottom line (most → least likely)
1. `Migrator.awaitAndRelease()` `runBlocking` on main — `MainActivity.kt:179` (+ `async(UNDISPATCHED)` migrations on main — `MigrationJobFactory.kt:22`).
2. `AppModule.kt:151-160` `getMainExecutor` building `Database` / `NetworkHelper` / `ExtensionManager` (loads all extensions via `runBlocking`, `ExtensionLoader.kt:166`) / `DownloadManager` on main.
3. `OcrScreenshotBuffer.init` synchronous JSON read — `App.kt:160` → `OcrScreenshotBuffer.kt:482-495`.
4. `OcrVocabulary.configure` synchronous file read — `App.kt:148` → `OcrVocabulary.kt:43-63`.
5. `getIncognitoState.await(null)` in composition — `MainActivity.kt:190`.
6. `WidgetManager` `updateAll` on main — `App.kt:239` → `WidgetManager.kt:32-39`.
7. Assorted pref I/O in `App.kt:162,228-230,236,256-258`.
8. Deferred `RuWordList.upper` (~3 M forms) on first OCR — `RuWordList.kt:79-97`.

package mihon.data.ocr

import mihon.domain.ocr.model.OcrModel
import mihon.domain.ocr.service.ScanRegion

/**
 * Требования плагина к окружению. UI по ним честно показывает, почему движок
 * недоступен, вместо падения или пустого результата.
 */
enum class OcrPluginRequirement {
    /** Нужен интернет. */
    NETWORK,

    /** Нужен скачанный пакет моделей (`cyrillic_ocr`). */
    MODEL_PACK,

    /** Нужен LiteRT (`com.google.ai.edge.litert`). */
    LITERT,

    /** Нужен API-ключ в настройках. */
    API_KEY,

    /** Нужен адрес своего сервера. */
    SERVER_ADDRESS,
}

/**
 * Описание одного OCR-движка как плагина.
 *
 * Реестр НЕ создаёт движки и не владеет ими: экземпляры по-прежнему живёт в
 * [OcrRepositoryImpl] вместе со своими мьютексами и кэшем моделей. Здесь лежит
 * только декларативная часть — id, название, требования, порядок во fallback-
 * цепочке и пресет тюнинга. Благодаря этому список движков можно показывать в
 * настройках, фильтровать по доступности и менять порядок фолбэков, не трогая
 * enum `OcrModel` и не переписывая замки.
 *
 * `engineType` намеренно строковый, а не `OcrRepositoryImpl.EngineType`: этот
 * тип `internal` и привязан к репозиторию, а реестр должен оставаться чистой
 * декларацией, которую можно тестировать без Android.
 */
data class OcrPluginDescriptor(
    val id: String,
    val model: OcrModel,
    val title: String,
    val summary: String,
    val engineType: String,
    val online: Boolean,
    val requirements: Set<OcrPluginRequirement> = emptySet(),
    /** Позиция в fallback-цепочке: меньше — раньше пробуется. */
    val fallbackPriority: Int,
    /** Пресет тюнинга, который лучше всего подходит этому движку. */
    val preferredContentType: OcrContentType = OcrContentType.BALANCED,
    /** Движок отдаёт границы областей, а не только текст. */
    val supportsRegions: Boolean = false,
    /** Миграционный хвост: значение enum, которое больше не выбирается в UI. */
    val legacy: Boolean = false,
)

/**
 * Реестр OCR-плагинов.
 *
 * Порядок [ALL] определяет порядок в настройках. [fallbackChain] повторяет
 * семантику прежних пресетов `pref_fallback_preset`
 * (auto / online / offline / single), но строится из данных реестра, а не из
 * зашитых списков в репозитории.
 */
object OcrPlugins {

    val CYRILLIC = OcrPluginDescriptor(
        id = "cyrillic_ppocr",
        model = OcrModel.CYRILLIC,
        title = "Локальный кириллический PP-OCR",
        summary = "PP-OCRv4 детектор + PP-OCRv3/v5 распознавание. Офлайн, основной русский движок.",
        engineType = "CYRILLIC",
        online = false,
        requirements = setOf(OcrPluginRequirement.MODEL_PACK, OcrPluginRequirement.LITERT),
        fallbackPriority = 0,
        supportsRegions = true,
    )

    /**
     * Настоящий Tesseract с русской моделью.
     *
     * До v1.10.18 пункт «Tesseract» в настройках был фикцией: он молча
     * отображался в PP-OCR, а дескриптора в реестре не было вовсе — из-за
     * чего движок пропадал из всех списков, строящихся по [ALL].
     */
    val TESSERACT = OcrPluginDescriptor(
        id = "tesseract",
        model = OcrModel.TESSERACT,
        title = "Tesseract (rus)",
        summary = "Офлайн-движок с русской моделью. Медленнее PP-OCR, зато читает " +
            "кириллицу иначе — годится там, где важно не ошибиться. " +
            "Языковые данные (~8 МБ) скачиваются при выборе.",
        engineType = "TESSERACT",
        online = false,
        requirements = setOf(OcrPluginRequirement.MODEL_PACK),
        // Ставим после PP-OCR: он и быстрее, и в среднем точнее на манге.
        fallbackPriority = 5,
    )


    val MLKIT = OcrPluginDescriptor(
        id = "mlkit",
        model = OcrModel.MLKIT,
        title = "Google ML Kit",
        summary = "Офлайн-модель Google ML Kit внутри APK для латинского текста. " +
            "Отдаёт строки с координатами. Сеть и загрузка моделей не нужны.",
        engineType = "MLKIT",
        online = false,
        requirements = emptySet(),
        fallbackPriority = 5,
        supportsRegions = true,
    )

    val GLENS = OcrPluginDescriptor(
        id = "google_lens",
        model = OcrModel.GLENS,
        title = "Google Lens",
        summary = "Онлайн-распознавание через Google Lens. Работает без ключа, но требует сеть.",
        engineType = "GLENS",
        online = true,
        requirements = setOf(OcrPluginRequirement.NETWORK),
        fallbackPriority = 10,
    )

    val ZEN_FREE = OcrPluginDescriptor(
        id = "zen_free",
        model = OcrModel.ZEN_FREE,
        title = "Space Bunny Free (OpenCode Zen)",
        summary = "Бесплатная vision-модель space-bunny-free через OpenCode Zen. Работает с ручным и автоматическим OCR.",
        engineType = "ZEN_FREE",
        online = true,
        requirements = setOf(OcrPluginRequirement.NETWORK),
        fallbackPriority = 20,
        supportsRegions = true,
    )

    val GOOGLE_AI = OcrPluginDescriptor(
        id = "google_ai",
        model = OcrModel.GOOGLE,
        title = "Google AI / Gemini Vision",
        summary = "Vision-модель Gemini. Нужен API-ключ Google AI.",
        engineType = "GOOGLE",
        online = true,
        requirements = setOf(OcrPluginRequirement.NETWORK, OcrPluginRequirement.API_KEY),
        fallbackPriority = 30,
    )

    val OPENROUTER = OcrPluginDescriptor(
        id = "openrouter",
        model = OcrModel.OPENROUTER,
        title = "OpenRouter",
        summary = "Любая vision-модель через OpenRouter. Нужен API-ключ.",
        engineType = "OPENROUTER",
        online = true,
        requirements = setOf(OcrPluginRequirement.NETWORK, OcrPluginRequirement.API_KEY),
        fallbackPriority = 40,
    )

    val OWOCR = OcrPluginDescriptor(
        id = "owocr",
        model = OcrModel.OWOCR,
        title = "OwOCR (свой сервер)",
        summary = "Self-hosted сервер OwOCR по WebSocket-адресу.",
        engineType = "OWOCR",
        online = true,
        requirements = setOf(OcrPluginRequirement.NETWORK, OcrPluginRequirement.SERVER_ADDRESS),
        fallbackPriority = 50,
    )

    /** Значения enum, которые оставлены только для миграции старых настроек. */
    val LEGACY_ALIASES = listOf(
        OcrModel.LEGACY to CYRILLIC.id,
        OcrModel.FAST to CYRILLIC.id,
    )

    /** Все выбираемые плагины в порядке показа в настройках. */
    val ALL = listOf(CYRILLIC, TESSERACT, MLKIT, GLENS, ZEN_FREE, GOOGLE_AI, OPENROUTER, OWOCR)


    private val BY_ID = ALL.associateBy { it.id }
    private val BY_ENGINE_TYPE = ALL.associateBy { it.engineType }
    private val BY_MODEL = ALL.associateBy { it.model }

    fun byId(id: String?): OcrPluginDescriptor? = id?.let { BY_ID[it] }

    fun byEngineType(engineType: String): OcrPluginDescriptor? = BY_ENGINE_TYPE[engineType]

    /**
     * Плагин для значения `pref_ocr_model`. Миграционные значения enum
     * прозрачно ведут на локальный кириллический движок — ровно так же, как
     * раньше это делал `selectedEngineType()` в репозитории.
     */
    fun byModel(model: OcrModel): OcrPluginDescriptor =
        BY_MODEL[model] ?: CYRILLIC

    /** Плагины, у которых выполнены все требования. */
    fun available(
        networkAvailable: Boolean,
        modelsInstalled: Boolean,
        litertAvailable: Boolean,
        hasApiKey: (OcrPluginDescriptor) -> Boolean = { false },
        hasServerAddress: (OcrPluginDescriptor) -> Boolean = { false },
    ): List<OcrPluginDescriptor> = ALL.filter { plugin ->
        plugin.requirements.all { requirement ->
            when (requirement) {
                OcrPluginRequirement.NETWORK -> networkAvailable
                OcrPluginRequirement.MODEL_PACK -> modelsInstalled
                OcrPluginRequirement.LITERT -> litertAvailable
                OcrPluginRequirement.API_KEY -> hasApiKey(plugin)
                OcrPluginRequirement.SERVER_ADDRESS -> hasServerAddress(plugin)
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Цепочка фолбэков без первичного движка.
     *
     * Порядок воспроизводит прежний `fallbackChain()` из `OcrRepositoryImpl`:
     * сначала онлайн-движки, затем локальные, внутри группы — по
     * [OcrPluginDescriptor.fallbackPriority]. Локальный движок намеренно
     * последний: он медленный, а онлайн обычно даёт лучший результат, поэтому
     * «авто» не должно начинаться с него.
     *
     * @param preset auto | online | offline | single — значения прежнего
     *   `pref_fallback_preset`, неизвестное значение читается как auto.
     */
    fun fallbackChain(
        primary: OcrPluginDescriptor,
        preset: String,
        networkAvailable: Boolean,
    ): List<OcrPluginDescriptor> {
        val pool = when (preset) {
            "single" -> return emptyList()
            "online" -> ALL.filter { it.online }
            "offline" -> ALL.filterNot { it.online }
            else -> if (networkAvailable) ALL else ALL.filterNot { it.online }
        }
        return pool
            .filter { it.id != primary.id }
            .sortedWith(compareByDescending<OcrPluginDescriptor> { it.online }.thenBy { it.fallbackPriority })
    }
}

/**
 * Профиль распознавания области страницы: пресет типа контента + область +
 * точные переопределения пользователя.
 */
data class OcrRegionProfile(
    val contentType: OcrContentType = OcrContentType.BALANCED,
    val scanRegion: ScanRegion = ScanRegion.FULL_PAGE,
    val localMode: OcrLocalMode = OcrLocalMode.ACCURATE,
    val overrides: OcrTuningOverrides = OcrTuningOverrides(),
) {
    /** Итоговые параметры для движка. */
    fun tuning(): OcrTuning = overrides.applyTo(
        OcrTuning.preset(contentType, scanRegion).withLocalMode(localMode),
    )
}

/**
 * Кириллические языки чтения.
 *
 * Встроенный ML Kit содержит только латинскую модель (движок
 * `com.google.mlkit:text-recognition-latin`), поэтому на русском тексте он не
 * «медленный», а бесполезный: либо молчит, либо выдаёт латинский мусор, который
 * авточтение произносит вслух. Такие страницы должны идти в локальный
 * кириллический движок — и как основной, и в цепочке фолбэка.
 */
internal fun isCyrillicOcrLanguage(code: String?): Boolean = when (code?.lowercase()?.trim()) {
    "ru", "uk", "be", "bg", "sr", "mk" -> true
    else -> false
}

236:             OcrModel.MLKIT -> EngineType.MLKIT

238:             // engine; the Japanese FAST/LEGACY models are no longer defaults.
239:             OcrModel.LEGACY -> EngineType.CYRILLIC
240:             OcrModel.FAST -> EngineType.CYRILLIC

244:             OcrModel.GOOGLE -> EngineType.GOOGLE

248:         }

258:     private fun isConnectivityFailure(error: Throwable): Boolean {
259:         var current: Throwable? = error
260:         while (current != null) {
261:             if (
262:                 current is UnknownHostException ||
263:                 current is ConnectException ||
264:                 current is SocketTimeoutException ||
265:                 current.message?.contains("Unable to resolve host", ignoreCase = true) == true
266:             ) {
267:                 return true
268:             }
269:             current = current.cause
270:         }
271:         return false
272:     }

294:     private fun isNetworkAvailable(): Boolean {
295:         return runCatching {
296:             val cm = context.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE)
297:                 as android.net.ConnectivityManager
298:             val caps = cm.getNetworkCapabilities(cm.activeNetwork)
299:             caps?.hasCapability(android.net.NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET) == true
300:         }.getOrDefault(false)
301:     }

303:     /**
304:      * Онлайн-движок реально готов к запросу: ключ/адрес заданы. Без этой
305:      * проверки цепочка тратила до минуты на заведомо 401/403-ответ.
306:      */
307:     private fun onlineEngineReady(type: EngineType): Boolean = when (type) {
308:         // Tesseract работает локально, сети ему не нужно.
309:         EngineType.TESSERACT -> true
310: 
311:         EngineType.ZEN_FREE -> ocrPreferences.zenFreeEnabled().get()
312:         EngineType.GOOGLE -> ocrPreferences.googleApiKey().get().isNotBlank()
313:         EngineType.OPENROUTER -> ocrPreferences.openrouterApiKey().get().isNotBlank()
314:         EngineType.OWOCR -> ocrPreferences.owocrAddress().get().isNotBlank()
315:         EngineType.GLENS -> true
316:         EngineType.CYRILLIC, EngineType.MLKIT, EngineType.FAST, EngineType.LEGACY -> false
317:     }

319:     /**
320:      * ЦЕПОЧКА фолбэков (по пресету пользователя), а не один шаг:
321:      *  auto    — при сети: онлайн → локальные; без сети: ТОЛЬКО локальные
322:      *            (онлайн даже не пробуются — мгновенный переход, без таймаутов);
323:      *  online  — только онлайн-движки;
324:      *  offline — только локальный Cyrillic PP-OCR (скачиваемый pack);
325:      *  single  — фолбэков нет.
326:      */
327:     private fun fallbackChain(primary: EngineType): List<EngineType> {
328:         // Дефолт — `offline`, а не `auto`. При `auto` цепочка включала онлайн-
329:         // движки, и картинка страницы уходила в GLENS/ZEN_FREE/Google без
330:         // явного согласия читателя. Теперь сеть в резервной цепочке появляется
331:         // только если её выбрали руками.
332:         val preset = preferenceStore.getString("pref_fallback_preset", "offline").get()
333: 
334:         val online = listOf(EngineType.GLENS, EngineType.ZEN_FREE, EngineType.GOOGLE)
335:             .filter { onlineEngineReady(it) }
336:         val chain = when (preset) {
337:             "single" -> emptyList()
338:             "online" -> online
339:             "offline" -> offlineEngines
340:             else -> { // auto
341:                 if (isNetworkAvailable()) online + offlineEngines else offlineEngines
342:             }
343:         }
344:         // Латинский ML Kit в кириллической цепочке — это не фолбэк, а шум:
345:         // он либо не ответит, либо прочитает русский текст латиницей.
346:         val cyrillic = readsCyrillic()
347:         return chain.filter { it != primary && !(cyrillic && it == EngineType.MLKIT) }
348:     }

447:      * Единственное место, где движок реально отработал: отмечаем его здесь,
448:      * иначе вызывающий код узнал бы только «первый, кто ответил», а это

451:     private suspend fun recognizeWithEngine(type: EngineType, image: Bitmap): String {
452:         return engineLocks.withTextEngineLock(type) {
453:             // Онлайн-модели отдают текст построчно и не склеивают переносы —
454:             // соединяем «пере-\nносится» в «переносится» централизованно.

459:     /**
460:      * @param fallbackBudgetMs сколько ждать резервных движков суммарно. Основной
461:      *   движок бюджетом не режется: его читатель выбрал сам, и обрывать его
462:      *   на полуслове нельзя. Режется только цепочка «просто попробуем ещё».
463:      * @param allowOnlineFallback сеть в резервной цепочке. Для мелкого кропа
464:      *   облако бесполезно и очень медленно, поэтому не пробуем.
465:      */
466:     private suspend fun recognizeWithFallback(
467:         primary: EngineType,
468:         image: Bitmap,
469:         fallbackBudgetMs: Long = defaultFallbackBudgetMs,
470:         allowOnlineFallback: Boolean = true,
471:     ): String {
472:         val skipPrimary = primary in onlineEngines && !isNetworkAvailable()
473:         val fallbackEnabled = useFallbackModelsPref.get()
474:         var primaryText: String? = null
475:         var lastError: Throwable? = null
476: 
477:         if (!skipPrimary) {
478:             try {
479:                 val text = recognizeWithEngine(primary, image)
480:                 primaryText = text
481:                 if (text.isNotBlank() || !fallbackEnabled) return text
482:             } catch (e: Throwable) {
483:                 if (e is CancellationException) throw e
484:                 lastError = e
485:             }
486:         }
487: 
488:         if (!fallbackEnabled) {
489:             return primaryText ?: throw lastError ?: OcrException.ConnectionError(null)
490:         }
491: 
492:         val deadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + fallbackBudgetMs
493:         for (engine in fallbackChain(primary)) {
494:             if (engine in onlineEngines && (!allowOnlineFallback || !isNetworkAvailable())) continue
495:             if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() > deadline) {
496:                 logcat(LogPriority.WARN) {
497:                     "OCR fallback budget ${fallbackBudgetMs}ms exhausted, " +
498:                         "stopping at ${engine.name.lowercase()}"
499:                 }
500:                 break
501:             }
502:             try {
503:                 logcat(LogPriority.WARN) {
504:                     "OCR (${primary.name.lowercase()}) returned no usable text, trying ${engine.name.lowercase()}"
505:                 }
506:                 val text = recognizeWithEngine(engine, image)
507:                 if (text.isNotBlank()) return text
508:             } catch (e: Throwable) {
509:                 if (e is CancellationException) throw e
510:                 lastError?.addSuppressed(e) ?: run { lastError = e }
511:             }
512:         }
513:         return primaryText ?: throw lastError ?: OcrException.InitializationError()
514:     }

531:                 image.useBitmap { bitmap ->
532:                     recognizeWithFallback(
533:                         primary = primary,
534:                         image = bitmap,
535:                         // Страница книги — не срочное чтение, но и не повод

541:             }

545:     /**
546:      * Локальный движок для страниц книги.
547:      *
548:      * Выбирается по фактической готовности, а не жёстко. Кириллический
549:      * PP-OCR — лучший для русского, но ему нужны скачанный пакет моделей и
550:      * LiteRT; без них он не отработает и страница просто останется пустой.
551:      * Тогда берётся Google ML Kit: он ВНУТРИ APK, ничего качать не надо, и
552:      * для латиницы работает сразу.
553:      *
554:      * Оба варианта локальные. Сети здесь нет ни в одном.

634:     override suspend fun scanPage(
635:         chapterId: Long,
636:         pageIndex: Int,
637:         image: OcrImage,
638:         onPartial: ((OcrRegion) -> Unit)?,
639:         cacheResult: Boolean,
640:     ): OcrPageResult {
641:         // Живой журнал. Консоль открывают именно ради скана главы, а движки
642:         // OCR ходят в сеть напрямую и минуют AiAssistant — из-за чего журнал был
643:         // пуст ровно тогда, когда он нужнее всего.
644:         val engineName = OcrPlugins.byModel(ocrModelPref.get()).title
645:         val startedAt = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
646:         AiConsole.ocr(
647:             title = "Скан страницы ${pageIndex + 1} · $engineName",
648:             detail = buildString {
649:                 append("chapterId=").append(chapterId)
650:                 append(" · ").append(image.width).append('×').append(image.height)
651:                 append(" · кэш: ").append(if (cacheResult) "да" else "нет")
652:             },
653:         )
654:         return try {
655:             val outcome = withActiveOperation {
656:                 val regionChoice = presetScanRegion()
657:             val result = image.useBitmap { originalBitmap ->
658:                 val sourceHeight = originalBitmap.height
659:                 val (cropTop, cropHeight) = OcrRegionRules.cropBounds(sourceHeight, regionChoice)
660: 
661:                 val crop = if (cropTop == 0 && cropHeight == sourceHeight) {
662:                     originalBitmap
663:                 } else {
664:                     Bitmap.createBitmap(
665:                         originalBitmap,
666:                         0,
667:                         cropTop,
668:                         originalBitmap.width,
669:                         cropHeight,
670:                     )
671:                 }
672:                 val croppedResult = try {
673:                     scanPageWithFallback(
674:                         chapterId = chapterId,
675:                         pageIndex = pageIndex,
676:                         image = crop,
677:                         primary = selectedEngineType(),
678:                         onPartial = onPartial,
679:                     )
680:                 } finally {
681:                     if (crop !== originalBitmap && !crop.isRecycled) crop.recycle()
682:                 }
683:                 croppedResult.copy(
684:                     imageHeight = sourceHeight,
685:                     regions = croppedResult.regions.mapNotNull { region ->
686:                         OcrBoxGeometry.restoreVerticalCrop(
687:                             box = region.boundingBox,
688:                             sourceHeight = sourceHeight,
689:                             cropTop = cropTop,
690:                             cropHeight = cropHeight,
691:                         )?.let { restored ->
692:                             region.copy(boundingBox = restored)
693:                         }
694:                     },
695:                 )
696:             }
697: 
698:             // Кадр авточтения — это окно вебтуна, а не страница: его рамки
699:             // нормализованы к обрезанному кадру. В кэш страницы такую запись
700:             // класть нельзя, иначе оверлей потом подсвечивал не там. Плюс
701:             // веб-авточтение шлёт chapterId = -1 на каждую позицию прокрутки,
702:             // и clearChapter такие записи не убирал.
703:                 if (cacheResult) cacheStore.upsert(result)
704:                 result
705:             }
706:             // Итог по странице: сколько реплик, сколько заняло, какой движок
707:             // отдал текст на самом деле (не выбранный, а фактический — при
708:             // фолбэке это разные движки).
709:             AiConsole.ocr(
710:                 title = "Страница ${pageIndex + 1} · реплик: ${outcome.regions.size}",
711:                 detail = "движок: ${OcrPlugins.byModel(outcome.ocrModel).title} · " +
712:                     "${android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - startedAt} мс",
713:                 level = if (outcome.regions.isEmpty()) AiConsole.Level.WARN else AiConsole.Level.OK,
714:             )
715:             outcome
716:         } catch (e: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) {
717:             throw e
718:         } catch (e: Exception) {
719:             AiConsole.ocr(
720:                 title = "Скан страницы ${pageIndex + 1} не удался · $engineName",
721:                 detail = e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName,
722:                 level = AiConsole.Level.ERROR,
723:             )
724:             throw e
725:         }
726:     }

776:     private suspend fun scanPageWithFallback(
777:         chapterId: Long,
778:         pageIndex: Int,
779:         image: Bitmap,
780:         primary: EngineType,
781:         onPartial: ((OcrRegion) -> Unit)? = null,
782:     ): OcrPageResult {
783:         val fallbackEnabled = useFallbackModelsPref.get()
784:         val skipUntitled = skipUntitledPagesPref.get()
785: 
786:         val engines = if (fallbackEnabled) listOf(primary) + fallbackChain(primary) else listOf(primary)
787:         var attempted = false
788:         var lastResult: OcrPageResult? = null
789:         var lastError: Throwable? = null
790: 
791:         for (engine in engines) {
792:             if (engine in onlineEngines && !isNetworkAvailable()) continue
793:             attempted = true
794:             try {
795:                 // Прогресс отдаётся только тому движку, который реально работает
796:                 // по областям: упавший движок мог наполнить канал мусором, и
797:                 // авточтение прочитало бы то, что потом отбросило.
798:                 val result = scanPageByEngine(chapterId, pageIndex, image, engine, onPartial)
799:                 val usable = result.withoutPromotionalRegions()
800:                 if (usable.regions.isNotEmpty()) return usable
801:                 lastResult = usable
802:                 // Движок отработал и не нашёл текста. Правило хода цепочки —
803:                 // в домене ([pageScanStepAfterEngine]), здесь только вывод в
804:                 // консоль: читатель должен видеть, почему страница прошла мимо.
805:                 if (
806:                     mihon.domain.ocr.interactor.pageScanStepAfterEngine(
807:                         failed = false,
808:                         regionCount = usable.regions.size,
809:                         skipUntitledPages = skipUntitled,
810:                     ) == mihon.domain.ocr.interactor.PageScanStep.STOP
811:                 ) {
812:                     AiConsole.ocr(
813:                         title = "Страница ${pageIndex + 1} · без текста",
814:                         detail = "${engine.name.lowercase()} не нашёл текста — " +
815:                             "цепочка фолбэка прервана, страница считается картинкой",
816:                         level = AiConsole.Level.INFO,
817:                     )
818:                     return usable
819:                 }
820: 
821:             } catch (error: Throwable) {
822:                 if (error is CancellationException) throw error
823:                 if (!fallbackEnabled) throw error
824:                 logcat(LogPriority.WARN, error) {
825:                     "OCR page scan ${engine.name.lowercase()} failed or returned no text"
826:                 }
827:                 lastError?.addSuppressed(error) ?: run { lastError = error }
828:             }
829:         }
830: 
831:         if (!attempted) throw lastError ?: OcrException.ConnectionError(null)
832:         return lastResult ?: throw lastError ?: OcrException.InitializationError()
833:     }

835:     private suspend fun scanPageByEngine(

843:         // запоминаем фактического исполнителя: тап по готовой странице
844:         // показывает подпись того движка, который её прочитал.
845:         noteEngineUsed(type)
846:         return when (type) {
847:             EngineType.CYRILLIC -> scanLocally(chapterId, pageIndex, image, OcrModel.CYRILLIC, type, onPartial)
848:             EngineType.TESSERACT -> scanWithTesseract(chapterId, pageIndex, image, type, onPartial)
849: 
850:             EngineType.MLKIT -> scanWithMlKit(chapterId, pageIndex, image, OcrModel.MLKIT, onPartial)
851:             EngineType.GLENS -> scanWithGlens(chapterId, pageIndex, image, OcrModel.GLENS)
852:             EngineType.OWOCR -> scanWithOwOcr(chapterId, pageIndex, image, OcrModel.OWOCR)
853:             EngineType.ZEN_FREE -> scanWithZenFree(chapterId, pageIndex, image)
854:             EngineType.OPENROUTER,
855:             EngineType.GOOGLE,
856:             -> scanWithTextEngine(chapterId, pageIndex, image, type)
857:             EngineType.LEGACY,
858:             EngineType.FAST,
859:             -> scanLocally(chapterId, pageIndex, image, OcrModel.CYRILLIC, EngineType.CYRILLIC, onPartial)
860:         }
861:     }

313:     /**
314:      * Downloads all files of a pack into ocr_models/ with .part staging so the
315:      * engines never pick up partially written files. Reports progress via toasts
316:      * and [onFinished] with success flag.
317:      */
318:     fun downloadPack(
319:         context: Context,
320:         pack: String,
321:         onFinished: (Boolean) -> Unit = {},
322:     ) {
323:         val files = PACKS[pack]
324:         if (files == null) {
325:             context.toast("Неизвестный пакет моделей: $pack")
326:             onFinished(false)
327:             return
328:         }
329: 
330:         scope.launch {
331:             val shouldStart = downloadMutex.withLock { activePacks.add(pack) }
332:             if (!shouldStart) {
333:                 withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { context.toast("Загрузка уже идёт…") }
334:                 return@launch
335:             }
336: 
337:             withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
338:                 context.toast("Загрузка моделей началась (${files.size} файл(ов))…")
339:             }
340: 
341:             setProgress(pack, 0f)
342:             val ok = try {
343:                 val baseDir = context.getExternalFilesDir(null)
344:                     ?.let { File(it, OcrModelFiles.MODELS_DIR) }
345:                     ?.apply { mkdirs() }
346: 
347:                 if (baseDir == null) {
348:                     false
349:                 } else {
350:                     // Прогресс по файлам: каждый файл — своя доля пака,
351:                     // внутри файла — по скачанным байтам (Content-Length).
352:                     // Pre-fetch Content-Length for all files to show total size
353:                     val fileSizes = files.map { (url, _) ->
354:                         runCatching {
355:                             val conn = (URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
356:                                 connectTimeout = 10_000
357:                                 requestMethod = "HEAD"
358:                             }
359:                             conn.disconnect()
360:                             conn.contentLengthLong.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 0L
361:                         }.getOrDefault(0L)
362:                     }
363:                     val totalPackSize = fileSizes.sum()
364:                     var done = 0
365:                     var totalDownloaded = 0L
366:                     // Частые onProgress (каждые 256 КБ) не должны спамить
367:                     // уведомлением: обновляем не чаще раза в секунду.
368:                     var lastNotifAt = 0L
369:                     files.all { (url, name) ->
370:                         val fileIndex = done
371:                         var fileDownloaded = 0L
372:                         // Основной URL + зеркала (jsDelivr): raw.githubusercontent
373:                         // иногда rate-limit-ит или недоступен — пробуем по порядку.
374:                         val candidates = listOf(url) + FILE_MIRRORS[name].orEmpty()
375:                         var r = false
376:                         for ((attempt, candidateUrl) in candidates.withIndex()) {
377:                             if (attempt > 0) {
378:                                 logcat(LogPriority.WARN) {
379:                                     "Pack $pack: primary source failed for $name, trying mirror"
380:                                 }
381:                             }
382:                             r = downloadFile(candidateUrl, File(baseDir, name)) { frac ->
383:                             val prev = fileDownloaded
384:                             fileDownloaded = (fileSizes[fileIndex] * frac).toLong()
385:                             totalDownloaded += (fileDownloaded - prev)
386:                             setProgress(pack, (fileIndex + frac) / files.size)
387:                             val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
388:                             if (frac >= 1f || now - lastNotifAt >= 1_000L) {
389:                                 lastNotifAt = now
390:                                 val pct = ((fileIndex + frac) / files.size * 100).toInt()
391:                                 showNotif(
392:                                     context,
393:                                     "Загрузка моделей: $pack",
394:                                     "${pct}% — файл ${fileIndex + 1}/${files.size}",
395:                                     pct,
396:                                     downloadedBytes = totalDownloaded,
397:                                     totalBytes = totalPackSize.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 0L,
398:                                     notifId = notifIdFor(pack),
399:                                 )
400:                             }
401:                         }
402:                             if (r) break
403:                         }
404:                         // If server didn't report size, track from actual download
405:                         if (fileSizes[fileIndex] == 0L) {
406:                             totalDownloaded += File(baseDir, name).length()
407:                         }
408:                         done++
409:                         r
410:                     }
411:                 }
412:             } catch (e: Throwable) {
413:                 logcat(LogPriority.ERROR, e) { "OCR model pack download failed: $pack" }
414:                 false
415:             } finally {
416:                 downloadMutex.withLock { activePacks.remove(pack) }
417:                 setProgress(pack, null)
418:                 // Гасим уведомление ИМЕННО этого пака: общий id отменял
419:                 // прогресс параллельной загрузки соседнего пака.
420:                 cancelNotif(context, notifIdFor(pack))
421:             }
422: 
423:             withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
424:                 if (ok) {
425:                     val size = installedSize(context, pack)
426:                     val sizeStr = if (size > 0) " (${formatSize(size)})" else ""
427:                     // ongoing=false: раньше тут отменяли уведомление и тут же
428:                     // публиковали НОВОЕ с setOngoing(true) под тем же id — оно
429:                     // висело несмахиваемым с полосой 100% до перезапуска.
430:                     showNotif(
431:                         context,
432:                         "Модели установлены",
433:                         "Локальный OCR готов$sizeStr",
434:                         100,
435:                         notifId = notifIdFor(pack),
436:                         ongoing = false,
437:                     )
438:                     context.toast("Модели установлены: локальный OCR готов к работе$sizeStr")
439:                 } else {
440:                     cancelNotif(context, notifIdFor(pack))
441:                     context.toast("Не удалось скачать модели. Проверьте интернет и повторите")
442:                 }
443:                 onFinished(ok)
444:             }
445:         }
446:     }
447: 
448:     private fun downloadFile(
449:         url: String,
450:         destination: File,
451:         onProgress: (Float) -> Unit = {},
452:     ): Boolean {
453:         if (destination.isFile && destination.length() > 0) {
454:             onProgress(1f)
455:             return true
456:         }
457: 
458:         destination.parentFile?.mkdirs() // паки с подпапками (tessdata/…)
459:         val part = File(destination.parentFile, destination.name + ".part")
460:         var connection: HttpURLConnection? = null
461:         return try {
462:             connection = (URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
463:                 connectTimeout = 30_000
464:                 readTimeout = 60_000
465:                 instanceFollowRedirects = true
466:             }
467:             if (connection.responseCode !in 200..299) {
468:                 logcat(LogPriority.WARN) { "Model download HTTP ${connection.responseCode} for $url" }
469:                 return false
470:             }
471:             val total = connection.contentLengthLong.takeIf { it > 0 }
472:             connection.inputStream.use { input ->
473:                 part.outputStream().use { output ->
474:                     val buf = ByteArray(256 * 1024)
475:                     var read = 0L
476:                     while (true) {
477:                         val n = input.read(buf)
478:                         if (n < 0) break
479:                         output.write(buf, 0, n)
480:                         read += n
481:                         if (total != null) onProgress((read.toFloat() / total).coerceIn(0f, 1f))
482:                     }
483:                 }
484:             }
485:             onProgress(1f)
486:             if (!part.renameTo(destination)) {
487:                 // Сбой переименования: оставлять .part нельзя — иначе каждая
488:                 // повторная попытка качает весь файл заново.
489:                 logcat(LogPriority.WARN) { "Model rename failed, clearing .part: $destination" }
490:                 part.delete()
491:                 return false
492:             }
493:             true
494:         } catch (e: Throwable) {
495:             logcat(LogPriority.WARN, e) { "Model file download failed: $url" }
496:             part.delete()
497:             false
498:         } finally {
499:             connection?.disconnect()
500:         }
501:     }
502: }

# Local OCR investigation

## Supplied visual regressions

The supplied screenshots establish four reproducible failure classes: words are fused without spaces, Cyrillic and Latin lookalikes are mixed, large unrelated UI text or page artwork is recognized, and some results are dictionary-index garbage such as ordered digits and letters.

The first two ordered tiles of `Screenshot_20260826-200005.png` show an ordinary comic speech balloon containing only `?!` immediately above the bottom-sheet OCR interface. This establishes a control case: a punctuation-only balloon must not yield invented lexical text, and the bottom sheet itself must never be part of the recognition source.

Tiles three and four preserve the same capture in reading order. They show a Korean sound-effect graphic, a comic speech bubble with the short text `А-А?`, and the OCR sheet overlapping the viewer. These regions are deliberately unsuitable for a Russian word recognizer and must be excluded by a minimum lexical-character threshold rather than converted into fabricated Russian words.

Tiles five and six continue the same scene and contain no additional Russian lexical text: the visible content is artwork, a Korean sound-effect, a partially hidden empty balloon, and the OCR UI. Together these tiles confirm that the local path needs a conservative acceptance policy: return no text for non-Cyrillic artwork/punctuation instead of passing low-confidence CTC fragments to transliteration.

The final tile contains a valid two-line Russian balloon: `ШУМНО,` followed by `В ТЕЛЕ ТЯЖЕСТЬ.`. It is a representative regression target for line ordering, Cyrillic preservation, and word-spacing. The adjacent overlap with tile six contains only the OCR sheet, so no comic text is lost at the tile boundary.

## Confirmed implementation facts

The local engine uses the pinned Cyrillic PP-OCRv3 recognizer as primary and PP-OCRv5 as a verifier. The downloaded models expose `[1, 40, 165]` and `[1, 40, 852]` outputs respectively; their dictionaries contain 163 and 850 entries. The v3 output is therefore one class larger than a direct blank-plus-dictionary mapping, and the decoder needs an explicit contract check rather than relying on a generic index assumption.

The model sources describe these as **text-line recognizers** and recommend a full OCR pipeline with detection and line-orientation handling. The current Android path needs to keep line segmentation strict, score both available recognizers fairly, reject malformed outputs, and avoid applying Russian transliteration to arbitrary Latin-only garbage.

# Local OCR investigation

## Supplied visual regressions

The supplied screenshots establish four reproducible failure classes: words are fused without spaces, Cyrillic and Latin lookalikes are mixed, large unrelated UI text or page artwork is recognized, and some results are dictionary-index garbage such as ordered digits and letters.

The first two ordered tiles of `Screenshot_20260826-200005.png` show an ordinary comic speech balloon containing only `?!` immediately above the bottom-sheet OCR interface. This establishes a control case: a punctuation-only balloon must not yield invented lexical text, and the bottom sheet itself must never be part of the recognition source.

Tiles three and four preserve the same capture in reading order. They show a Korean sound-effect graphic, a comic speech bubble with the short text `А-А?`, and the OCR sheet overlapping the viewer. These regions are deliberately unsuitable for a Russian word recognizer and must be excluded by a minimum lexical-character threshold rather than converted into fabricated Russian words.

Tiles five and six continue the same scene and contain no additional Russian lexical text: the visible content is artwork, a Korean sound-effect, a partially hidden empty balloon, and the OCR UI. Together these tiles confirm that the local path needs a conservative acceptance policy: return no text for non-Cyrillic artwork/punctuation instead of passing low-confidence CTC fragments to transliteration.

The final tile contains a valid two-line Russian balloon: `ШУМНО,` followed by `В ТЕЛЕ ТЯЖЕСТЬ.`. It is a representative regression target for line ordering, Cyrillic preservation, and word-spacing. The adjacent overlap with tile six contains only the OCR sheet, so no comic text is lost at the tile boundary.

## Confirmed implementation facts

The local engine uses the pinned Cyrillic PP-OCRv3 recognizer as primary and PP-OCRv5 as a verifier. The downloaded models expose `[1, 40, 165]` and `[1, 40, 852]` outputs respectively; their dictionaries contain 163 and 850 entries. The v3 output is therefore one class larger than a direct blank-plus-dictionary mapping, and the decoder needs an explicit contract check rather than relying on a generic index assumption.

The model sources describe these as **text-line recognizers** and recommend a full OCR pipeline with detection and line-orientation handling. The current Android path needs to keep line segmentation strict, score both available recognizers fairly, reject malformed outputs, and avoid applying Russian transliteration to arbitrary Latin-only garbage.

## Device-validation correction

The first repair did not meet the supplied device regression. The current APK still selected poor PP-OCRv3 output for clean, horizontal Cyrillic captions. On `Screenshot_20260826-214703.png`, the detector correctly returned four caption lines, but v3 produced mixed Latin output while v5 produced the same lines as `ОнБыл`, `ЛОЖНООБВИНЕН`, `ВСГОВОРЕ`, and `СДЕМОНОМ` with much higher confidences for three of four lines. This proves the primary problem is **candidate ranking and word restoration**, not failure to detect the text panel.

The next repair must always evaluate PP-OCRv5 on a detected Cyrillic line and rank its result against v3 using script validity and character confidence. It must then add spaces only through a conservative local Russian lexicon; it must not use a free-form language model or invent text.

### External model references

The [PP-OCRv3 Cyrillic model card](https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/cyrillic_PP-OCRv3_mobile_rec) describes the model as a text-line recognizer and documents a multi-stage OCR pipeline. The [PP-OCRv5 Cyrillic model card](https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/cyrillic_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec) documents the newer Cyrillic recognizer and its multi-stage pipeline. The [PaddleOCR recognition documentation](https://paddlepaddle.github.io/PaddleOCR/main/en/version3.x/module_usage/text_recognition.html) explains that recognition operates on text regions supplied by detection.

# OCR engine / model selection flow — Yomikai

## 1. Where OCR engines are defined and selected

**Engine interface and implementations**
- `OcrEngine` interface — `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/OcrEngine.kt:9`; `LineOcrEngine` — `OcrEngine.kt:29`
- `CyrillicOcrEngine` — `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/CyrillicOcrEngine.kt:38` (local PP-OCRv3+v5)
- `MlKitOcrEngine` — `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/MlKitOcrEngine.kt:27`
- `TesseractOcrEngine` — `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/TesseractOcrEngine.kt:35`
- `GoogleAiOcrEngine` — `.../GoogleAiOcrEngine.kt:21`
- `OpenRouterOcrEngine` — `.../OpenRouterOcrEngine.kt:20`
- `FastOcrEngine` — `.../FastOcrEngine.kt:26`
- `GlensOcrEngine` — `.../GlensOcrEngine.kt:22`
- `LegacyOcrEngine` — `.../LegacyOcrEngine.kt:23`
- `OwOcrEngine` — `.../OwOcrEngine.kt:67`
- `ZenFreeOcrEngine` — `.../ZenFreeOcrEngine.kt:18`
- Detector wrapper `CyrillicDetOcrEngine` / `UnavailableDetOcrEngine` — `.../DetOcrEngine.kt:13,30`

**Declarative registry** — `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/OcrPlugins.kt:67`
- Descriptors: `CYRILLIC` `:69`, `TESSERACT` `:88`, `MLKIT` `:103`, `GLENS` `:116`, `ZEN_FREE` `:127`, `GOOGLE_AI` `:139`, `OPENROUTER` `:150`, `OWOCR` `:161`; ordered list `ALL` `:179`.
- Legacy aliasing (`LEGACY`/`FAST` → Cyrillic) — `:173-176`, `byModel()` `:195-196`.

**Instance factory / selection** — `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/OcrRepositoryImpl.kt`
- Engine fields (caches) — `:110-123`
- `EngineType` enum — `:210-222`
- `selectedEngineType()` — `:224`; `engineTypeOf()` — `:233-253`
- `engineFor(type)` lazily creates one engine — `:360-417`
- `offlineEngines` / `onlineEngines` fallback pools — `:274-292`
- `fallbackChain()` — `:327-348`

## 2. Active/default engine choice on first use

- The persisted preference is `pref_ocr_model`, **defaulting to `OcrModel.CYRILLIC`**:
  - `OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:40` → `preferenceStore.getEnum("pref_ocr_model", OcrModel.CYRILLIC)`
  - `domain/.../OcrPreferences.kt:17` → same default
- `recognizeText()` resolves the engine with no user input: `OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:584` (`model?.let(::engineTypeOf) ?: selectedEngineType()`); `scanPage()` at `:677`; `askAboutImage()` at `:623`.
- **There is no first-run engine/model chooser dialog.** The only onboarding touchpoint is `OcrModelStep` (`app/.../onboarding/OcrModelStep.kt:33`), and it is *not* an engine chooser:
  - `isComplete = true` (`:35`) — never blocks, skippable.
  - It offers only "Download Cyrillic OCR" vs "Download later" (`:65-127`); clicking card 0 forcibly sets `OcrModel.CYRILLIC` (`:68`) and starts the download (`:69`). The model was already the default anyway.
  - It is registered in the onboarding list at `OnboardingScreen.kt:42`.
- Real choosers (all post-hoc, buried in settings/reader):
  - `SettingsHubScreen.kt` OCR tab "Движок распознавания" — `:882-911`
  - `SettingsOcrScreen.getEnginesGroup` — `SettingsOcrScreen.kt:349-359`
  - Reader quick switcher `OcrModelQuickSwitcher` — `ReaderTopBar.kt:151-255`
  - `LocalOcrScreens.EngineOptions` — `LocalOcrScreens.kt:166-188`
  - `SettingsOcrPluginsScreen.kt` is **read-only** ("Экран ничего не переключает", `:24`).

## 3. What happens automatically on first OCR run (eager work)

Two eager paths run **without any user choice**:

**(a) App startup auto-download** — `MainActivity.onCreate()` calls `ensureOcrModelsInstalled()` at `app/.../ui/main/MainActivity.kt:177`, defined at `app/.../App.kt:364-384`:
- Unconditionally migrates `LEGACY`/`FAST`/`TESSERACT` → `CYRILLIC` (`App.kt:368-377`).
- If `cyrillic_ocr` is not installed, starts `downloadPack(..., "cyrillic_ocr")` (`App.kt:379-380`) on a `Thread.MIN_PRIORITY` named `cyrillic-ocr-init` (`:383`).
- Pack is ~21 MB / 5 files — `OcrModelDownloader.kt:125-131` (detector, v3, v5, 2 dicts), URLs `:172-174`, mirrors `:202-213`.
- Startup also resumes queued scans: `App.kt:138` → `OcrScanManager.startIfPending()` (`OcrScanManager.kt:45`).

**(b) Reader open warms up the engine eagerly** — `ReaderActivity.onCreate()` calls `viewModel.warmupOcr()` at `ui/reader/ReaderActivity.kt:545`, defined at `ReaderViewModel.kt:900-913`:
- It builds a 64×64 bitmap and calls `ocrProcessor.getText(...)` (`:907`) → `OcrProcessor.getText` → `OcrRepository.recognizeText` (`OcrProcessor.kt:10-12`) → default `CYRILLIC` engine.
- That constructs `CyrillicOcrEngine` (`OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:363-368`) and calls `ensureInitialized()` → `init()` (`CyrillicOcrEngine.kt:156-209`), which loads **three TFLite models** (detector + v3 + v5) and **two dictionaries** (`:175-191`) using `availableProcessors().coerceIn(2,4)` CPU threads (`:171-174`). This is the main CPU/RAM spike and the "phone slows down" symptom.

No multiple engines are initialized at once in the normal path: `engineFor` instantiates lazily one engine at a time and caches (`OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:360-417`). The eager cost is the 21 MB `cyrillic_ocr` download plus the 3-model/2-thread Cyrillic init, both triggered before the user ever picks an engine.

Other implicit downloads (on demand, not first-run): Tesseract data auto-downloaded when Tesseract is selected — `SettingsHubScreen.kt:891-908` → `OcrModelDownloader.ensureTesseractData` (`OcrModelDownloader.kt:284-299`); panel detector `ensurePanelDetector` (`:263-272`, now unused per `DomainModule.kt:323`).

## 4. Language / script selection ("voices"/languages)

- Auto-read language `pref_autoread_language`, **default `"ru"`** — `OcrPreferences.kt:242`.
  - Chooser in settings hub — `SettingsHubScreen.kt:642-645, 708-720` (ru/en/ja/ko/zh/any).
  - In-reader chooser — `OcrBubbleSettingsDialog.kt:67, 190`.
- This language drives engine remapping: `readsCyrillic()` (`OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:256`) + `isCyrillicOcrLanguage()` (`OcrPlugins.kt:271-274`); because the default is `"ru"`, `engineTypeOf()` silently rewrites `MLKIT` → `CYRILLIC` (`OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:249-252`).
- Per-engine language settings:
  - Glens language/region — `OcrPreferences.kt:107-108`; chooser `SettingsOcrScreen.kt:384-429`.
  - Tesseract langs `pref_tess_langs` default `"eng+rus"` — `OcrPreferences.kt:311`; chooser `SettingsHubScreen.kt:1132, 1172`.
- No language/script prompt fires before the first OCR; it uses the `"ru"` default. (Voice/TTS enumeration is separate — `OcrPreferences.kt:130-206`, `TtsVoicePickerDialog.kt`.)

## 5. Eager vs lazy initialization summary

- **Lazy:** engines are created on demand in `engineFor` and cached (`OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:360-417`); only the primary engine (plus on-failure fallbacks) is touched (`recognizeWithFallback` `:466-514`, `scanPageWithFallback` `:776-833`). `closeEngines()` tears all down — `:1338-1377`.
- **Eager:**
  1. `cyrillic_ocr` (~21 MB) auto-download at every app start — `App.kt:364-384`, `MainActivity.kt:177`; files `OcrModelDownloader.kt:125-131`.
  2. Cyrillic model init (3 TFLite + 2 dicts, 2–4 threads) on every reader open — `ReaderViewModel.kt:900-913`, `ReaderActivity.kt:545`, `CyrillicOcrEngine.kt:163-209`.
  3. Pending scan queue resumed at startup — `App.kt:138`.
  4. `OcrPluginAvailability.availableIds()` creates+closes a LiteRT environment on every settings/hub composition — `OcrPluginAvailability.kt:28-30`, called from `SettingsOcrPluginsScreen.kt:40-52` and `SettingsOcrScreen.kt:77-90`.

---

## Selection flow map

```
Engine registry            OcrPlugins.ALL                       OcrPlugins.kt:179
        │                  descriptors :69-170
        ▼
Default pref (no prompt)   pref_ocr_model = CYRILLIC           OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:40
                                                               OcrPreferences.kt:17
        ▼
Resolver                   selectedEngineType() :224           OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:224
                           engineTypeOf() :233-253 (MLKIT→CYRILLIC if ru :252)
        ▼
Eager on app start         ensureOcrModelsInstalled()          App.kt:364-384
                           ← MainActivity.kt:177
                           auto-downloads cyrillic_ocr 21MB    OcrModelDownloader.kt:125-131
        ▼
Eager on reader open       warmupOcr()                        ReaderViewModel.kt:900
                           ← ReaderActivity.kt:545
                           → CyrillicOcrEngine.init()           CyrillicOcrEngine.kt:163
                             loads det+v3+v5+2 dicts, 2-4 thr  CyrillicOcrEngine.kt:171-191
        ▼
Lazy per-request           engineFor(type) one cached engine  OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:360
        ▼
User choosers (post-hoc)   SettingsHubScreen.kt:882            (only after the fact)
                           SettingsOcrScreen.kt:349
                           ReaderTopBar.kt:151
```

## Called-out gaps

- **Missing first-run chooser:** there is no prompt letting the user pick an engine/model before first use. The engine is silently defaulted to `CYRILLIC` at `OcrRepositoryImpl.kt:40` / `OcrPreferences.kt:17`. The onboarding `OcrModelStep` (`OcrModelStep.kt:33`) is only a download-now/later card, is always "complete" (`:35`), and hard-sets `CYRILLIC` (`:68`).
- **Eager init/download sites:** `App.kt:364-384` (startup 21 MB download, called from `MainActivity.kt:177`) and `ReaderViewModel.kt:900` (reader-open model warm-up, called from `ReaderActivity.kt:545`), which together load/download the Cyrillic pack and the 3 large TFLite models + dictionaries (`CyrillicOcrEngine.kt:163-209`) before the user has made any selection — the likely cause of the perceived slowdown.
